_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/triggers/test_state_trigger.py. t_st_tome is Mazemind Tome's state trigger on an ability that needs no tap, so page counters can be put on at instant speed while the trigger waits: the first ability's cost is the counter and its effect a 1-life marker, the state trigger exiles the tome and, if it did, gains 10.

cards.name: Test State Tome
cards.oracle_text:
Put a page counter on this artifact: You gain 1 life.
When there are four or more page counters on this artifact, exile it. If you do, you gain 10 life.
